exchanges.content_summary: Asked to confirm tonicity anchor and whether Fig 4 / ADA 2026 Fig 16.1 say hold insulin if K<3.5 without admission qualifier

A1-A4 agree; B(i) partial agree (K not a resolution criterion; replete to 4-5 and recheck Mg around transition; K<3.5 not by itself reason to withhold SC basal); B(ii),(iii) agree; notes ADA 2026 internal 2 h vs 2-4 h overlap inconsistency

Fig 4 visually verified: K<3.5 -> 10-20 mmol l-1 h-1 until >3.5, central access for faster; no hold-insulin text; text-vs-figure discrepancies recorded; C1 agree; ADA 2026 Fig 16.1 numbers not verified
